shape.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. Defines the shape of the output tensor.
constraints: At most one component can be -1
shape must be one of int32, int64
-1 can be used to infer the shape

name.description: Optional string. A name for the operation.

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `tensor`.

constraints: The total number of elements must remain constant
If -1 is used, it will be computed so that the total size remains constant
